    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=C["dotcom"], lw=0.6, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.15'),
)

ai_peak_i = ai_y.index(max(ai_y))
ax1.plot(ai_x[ai_peak_i], ai_y[ai_peak_i], 'o', color=C["ai"], markersize=5, zorder=5)
ax1.annotate(
    f'AI-era high\nQ4 2024 · {ai_y[ai_peak_i]:.0f}',
    xy=(ai_x[ai_peak_i], ai_y[ai_peak_i]),
    xytext=(ai_x[ai_peak_i] - 5, ai_y[ai_peak_i] + 35),
    fontsize=9.5, fontstyle='italic', color=C["ai"], fontfamily='serif',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=C["ai"], lw=0.6, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.15'),
)

# Direct labels at endpoints
ax1.text(dc_x[-1] + 0.5, dc_y[-1], 'Dot-com', fontsize=10.5, color=C["dotcom"],
         fontfamily='serif', va='center', clip_on=False)
ax1.text(ai_x[-1] + 0.5, ai_y[-1], 'AI', fontsize=10.5, color=C["ai"],
         fontfamily='serif', va='center', clip_on=False)

# Base reference
ax1.axhline(y=100, color=C["axis"], linewidth=0.5, linestyle='--', zorder=1, alpha=0.7)
ax1.text(23.5, 103, "base", fontsize=8, color=C["text3"], fontfamily='serif',
         ha='right', va='bottom')

# Horizontal gridlines at low opacity for reading precise values
for yval in [100, 150, 200, 250, 300]:
    ax1.axhline(y=yval, color='#eeeeee', linewidth=0.4, zorder=0, alpha=0.6)

add_dual_x_labels(ax1)
range_frame(ax1, 0, 23, min(min(dc_y), min(ai_y)) * 0.88, max(dc_y) * 1.06)
ax1.set_ylabel("Index (base = 100)", fontsize=10.5, color=C["text2"])
ax1.set_title("NASDAQ Composite Trajectory", fontsize=14, fontfamily='serif',
              color=C["text"], loc='left', pad=10)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel 2: P/E Ratio
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
dc_pe_x = [d["quarter_offset"] for d in dc_pe]
dc_pe_y = [d["pe"] for d in dc_pe]
ai_pe_x = [d["quarter_offset"] for d in ai_pe]
ai_pe_y = [d["pe"] for d in ai_pe]

ax2.plot(dc_pe_x, dc_pe_y, color=C["dotcom"], linewidth=2, zorder=3, solid_capstyle="round")
ax2.plot(ai_pe_x, ai_pe_y, color=C["ai"], linewidth=2, zorder=3, solid_capstyle="round")

# Dots for sparse data points
ax2.plot(dc_pe_x, dc_pe_y, 'o', color=C["dotcom"], markersize=3, zorder=4)
ax2.plot(ai_pe_x, ai_pe_y, 'o', color=C["ai"], markersize=3, zorder=4)

# Annotate dot-com P/E peak
dc_pe_peak_i = dc_pe_y.index(max(dc_pe_y))
ax2.annotate(
    f'Peak: {dc_pe_y[dc_pe_peak_i]:.0f}×',
    xy=(dc_pe_x[dc_pe_peak_i], dc_pe_y[dc_pe_peak_i]),
    xytext=(dc_pe_x[dc_pe_peak_i] + 3, dc_pe_y[dc_pe_peak_i] + 2),
    fontsize=9.5, fontstyle='italic', color=C["dotcom"], fontfamily='serif',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=C["dotcom"], lw=0.6),
)

# Current AI-era P/E
ax2.annotate(
    f'{ai_pe_y[-1]:.0f}×',
    xy=(ai_pe_x[-1], ai_pe_y[-1]),
    xytext=(ai_pe_x[-1] + 0.5, ai_pe_y[-1]),
    fontsize=9, color=C["ai"], fontfamily='serif', va='center',
)

# Reference: historical average
ax2.axhline(y=30, color=C["axis"], linewidth=0.5, linestyle=':', zorder=1, alpha=0.8)
ax2.text(0.5, 31.8, "Long-run average ≈ 30×", fontsize=8.5, color=C["text3"], fontfamily='serif')

# Shaded divergence area (dot-com speculative premium)
ax2.fill_between(
    [dc_pe_x[i] for i in range(len(dc_pe_x))],

    [ai_pe_y[max(0, min(i, len(ai_pe_y)-1))] for i in range(len(dc_pe_x))],

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib as mpl
import numpy as np
import json

# ── Load data ──
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# ── Tufte rcParams ──
TUFTE_RC = {
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Palatino", "Palatino Linotype", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 12,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "figure.dpi": 150,
    "axes.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "axes.edgecolor": "#cccccc",
    "axes.linewidth": 0.5,
    "axes.labelcolor": "#666666",
    "axes.labelsize": 11,
    "axes.titlesize": 14,
    "axes.titleweight": "normal",
    "axes.titlepad": 8,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.grid": False,
    "xtick.color": "#999999",
    "ytick.color": "#999999",
    "xtick.labelsize": 10,
    "ytick.labelsize": 10,
    "xtick.direction": "in",
    "ytick.direction": "in",
    "xtick.major.size": 3,
    "ytick.major.size": 3,
    "xtick.major.width": 0.5,
    "ytick.major.width": 0.5,
    "lines.linewidth": 1.5,
    "lines.markersize": 3,
    "legend.frameon": False,
    "legend.fontsize": 11,
    "grid.color": "#eeeeee",
    "grid.linewidth": 0.5,
    "grid.alpha": 0.5,
    "savefig.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.3,
}
plt.rcParams.update(TUFTE_RC)

C = {
    "bg": "#fffff8",
    "text": "#111111",
    "text2": "#666666",
    "text3": "#999999",
    "axis": "#cccccc",
    "dotcom": "#4e79a7",
    "ai": "#f28e2b",
    "highlight": "#e41a1c",
    "series": "#666666",
}

# ── Prepare data ──
nasdaq = data["nasdaq_index"]["data"]
pe = data["pe_ratio"]["data"]
ipo = data["ipo_counts"]["data"]
earnings = data["corporate_earnings"]["data"]

dc_nq = [d for d in nasdaq if d["era"] == "Dot-com"]
ai_nq = [d for d in nasdaq if d["era"] == "AI"]
dc_pe = [d for d in pe if d["era"] == "Dot-com"]
ai_pe = [d for d in pe if d["era"] == "AI"]
dc_ipo = [d for d in ipo if d["era"] == "Dot-com"]
ai_ipo = [d for d in ipo if d["era"] == "AI"]
dc_earn = [d for d in earnings if d["era"] == "Dot-com"]
ai_earn = [d for d in earnings if d["era"] == "AI"]

# ── Helper: range-frame ──
def range_frame(ax, x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max):
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(x_min, x_max)
    ax.spines["left"].set_bounds(y_min, y_max)

# ── Dual-era x-axis labels for quarterly panels ──
yr_ticks = [0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20]
dc_yr_labels = ["1997", "1998", "1999", "2000", "2001", "2002"]
ai_yr_labels = ["2021", "2022", "2023", "2024", "", ""]

def add_dual_x_labels(ax):
    """Add two rows of year labels: dot-com (top row) and AI (bottom row), color-coded."""
    ax.set_xticks(yr_ticks)
    ax.set_xticklabels(dc_yr_labels, fontsize=9)
    # Add AI-era year labels below the dot-com labels
    for i, (tick, label) in enumerate(zip(yr_ticks, ai_yr_labels)):
        if label:
            ax.text(tick, -0.09, label, transform=ax.get_xaxis_transform(),
                    fontsize=8, color=C["ai"], fontfamily='serif', ha='center', va='top')
    # Color the dot-com year labels
    for i, label_obj in enumerate(ax.get_xticklabels()):
        label_obj.set_color(C["dotcom"])
        label_obj.set_fontsize(9)

# ── Create figure ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 13.5))

# Manual axes positioning for better control
# [left, bottom, width, height]
ax1 = fig.add_axes([0.10, 0.745, 0.84, 0.19])
ax2 = fig.add_axes([0.10, 0.52, 0.84, 0.175])
ax3 = fig.add_axes([0.10, 0.29, 0.84, 0.17])
ax4 = fig.add_axes([0.10, 0.06, 0.84, 0.19])

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel 1: NASDAQ Composite Index Trajectory
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
dc_x = [d["quarter_offset"] for d in dc_nq]
dc_y = [d["index_value"] for d in dc_nq]
ai_x = [d["quarter_offset"] for d in ai_nq]
ai_y = [d["index_value"] for d in ai_nq]

ax1.plot(dc_x, dc_y, color=C["dotcom"], linewidth=2, zorder=3, solid_capstyle="round")
ax1.plot(ai_x, ai_y, color=C["ai"], linewidth=2, zorder=3, solid_capstyle="round")

# Peak markers
dc_peak_i = dc_y.index(max(dc_y))
ax1.plot(dc_x[dc_peak_i], dc_y[dc_peak_i], 'o', color=C["dotcom"], markersize=5, zorder=5)
ax1.annotate(
    f'Dot-com peak\nMar 2000 · {dc_y[dc_peak_i]:.0f}',
    xy=(dc_x[dc_peak_i], dc_y[dc_peak_i]),
    xytext=(dc_x[dc_peak_i] + 3.5, dc_y[dc_peak_i] - 25),
    fontsize=9.5, fontstyle='italic', color=C["dotcom"], fontfamily='serif',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=C["dotcom"], lw=0.6, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.15'),
)

ai_peak_i = ai_y.index(max(ai_y))
ax1.plot(ai_x[ai_peak_i], ai_y[ai_peak_i], 'o', color=C["ai"], markersize=5, zorder=5)
ax1.annotate(
    f'AI-era high\nQ4 2024 · {ai_y[ai_peak_i]:.0f}',
    xy=(ai_x[ai_peak_i], ai_y[ai_peak_i]),
    xytext=(ai_x[ai_peak_i] - 5, ai_y[ai_peak_i] + 35),
    fontsize=9.5, fontstyle='italic', color=C["ai"], fontfamily='serif',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=C["ai"], lw=0.6, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.15'),
)

# Direct labels at endpoints
ax1.text(dc_x[-1] + 0.5, dc_y[-1], 'Dot-com', fontsize=10.5, color=C["dotcom"],
         fontfamily='serif', va='center', clip_on=False)
ax1.text(ai_x[-1] + 0.5, ai_y[-1], 'AI', fontsize=10.5, color=C["ai"],
         fontfamily='serif', va='center', clip_on=False)

# Base reference
ax1.axhline(y=100, color=C["axis"], linewidth=0.5, linestyle='--', zorder=1, alpha=0.7)
ax1.text(23.5, 103, "base", fontsize=8, color=C["text3"], fontfamily='serif',
         ha='right', va='bottom')

# Horizontal gridlines at low opacity for reading precise values
for yval in [100, 150, 200, 250, 300]:
    ax1.axhline(y=yval, color='#eeeeee', linewidth=0.4, zorder=0, alpha=0.6)

add_dual_x_labels(ax1)
range_frame(ax1, 0, 23, min(min(dc_y), min(ai_y)) * 0.88, max(dc_y) * 1.06)
ax1.set_ylabel("Index (base = 100)", fontsize=10.5, color=C["text2"])
ax1.set_title("NASDAQ Composite Trajectory", fontsize=14, fontfamily='serif',
              color=C["text"], loc='left', pad=10)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel 2: P/E Ratio
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
dc_pe_x = [d["quarter_offset"] for d in dc_pe]
dc_pe_y = [d["pe"] for d in dc_pe]
ai_pe_x = [d["quarter_offset"] for d in ai_pe]
ai_pe_y = [d["pe"] for d in ai_pe]

ax2.plot(dc_pe_x, dc_pe_y, color=C["dotcom"], linewidth=2, zorder=3, solid_capstyle="round")
ax2.plot(ai_pe_x, ai_pe_y, color=C["ai"], linewidth=2, zorder=3, solid_capstyle="round")

# Dots for sparse data points
ax2.plot(dc_pe_x, dc_pe_y, 'o', color=C["dotcom"], markersize=3, zorder=4)
ax2.plot(ai_pe_x, ai_pe_y, 'o', color=C["ai"], markersize=3, zorder=4)

# Annotate dot-com P/E peak
dc_pe_peak_i = dc_pe_y.index(max(dc_pe_y))
ax2.annotate(
    f'Peak: {dc_pe_y[dc_pe_peak_i]:.0f}×',
    xy=(dc_pe_x[dc_pe_peak_i], dc_pe_y[dc_pe_peak_i]),
    xytext=(dc_pe_x[dc_pe_peak_i] + 3, dc_pe_y[dc_pe_peak_i] + 2),
    fontsize=9.5, fontstyle='italic', color=C["dotcom"], fontfamily='serif',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=C["dotcom"], lw=0.6),
)

# Current AI-era P/E
ax2.annotate(
    f'{ai_pe_y[-1]:.0f}×',
    xy=(ai_pe_x[-1], ai_pe_y[-1]),
    xytext=(ai_pe_x[-1] + 0.5, ai_pe_y[-1]),
    fontsize=9, color=C["ai"], fontfamily='serif', va='center',
)

# Reference: historical average
ax2.axhline(y=30, color=C["axis"], linewidth=0.5, linestyle=':', zorder=1, alpha=0.8)
ax2.text(0.5, 31.8, "Long-run average ≈ 30×", fontsize=8.5, color=C["text3"], fontfamily='serif')

# Shaded divergence area (dot-com speculative premium)
ax2.fill_between(
    [dc_pe_x[i] for i in range(len(dc_pe_x))],
    dc_pe_y,
    [ai_pe_y[max(0, min(i, len(ai_pe_y)-1))] for i in range(len(dc_pe_x))],
    alpha=0.06, color=C["dotcom"], zorder=0
)
ax2.text(11, 72, "Dot-com\nspeculative\npremium", fontsize=8.5, color=C["dotcom"],
         fontfamily='serif', alpha=0.5, ha='center', fontstyle='italic')

# Direct labels
ax2.text(dc_pe_x[-1] + 0.5, dc_pe_y[-1], 'Dot-com', fontsize=10.5, color=C["dotcom"],
         fontfamily='serif', va='center', clip_on=False)

add_dual_x_labels(ax2)
all_pe = dc_pe_y + ai_pe_y
range_frame(ax2, 0, 23, min(all_pe) * 0.85, max(dc_pe_y) * 1.06)
ax2.set_ylabel("P/E Ratio (×)", fontsize=10.5, color=C["text2"])
ax2.set_title("Valuation: Trailing Price-to-Earnings", fontsize=14, fontfamily='serif',
              color=C["text"], loc='left', pad=10)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel 3: Tech IPO Volume
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
dc_ipo_x = [d["year"] - 1997 for d in dc_ipo]
dc_ipo_y = [d["ipo_count"] for d in dc_ipo]
ai_ipo_x = [d["year"] - 2021 for d in ai_ipo]
ai_ipo_y = [d["ipo_count"] for d in ai_ipo]

bw = 0.35
ax3.bar([x - bw/2 for x in dc_ipo_x], dc_ipo_y, width=bw,
        color=C["dotcom"], alpha=0.8, zorder=3)
ax3.bar([x + bw/2 for x in ai_ipo_x], ai_ipo_y, width=bw,
        color=C["ai"], alpha=0.8, zorder=3)

# Value labels on bars
for x, y in zip(dc_ipo_x, dc_ipo_y):
    ax3.text(x - bw/2, y + 6, str(y), ha='center', fontsize=8.5,
             color=C["dotcom"], fontfamily='serif')
for x, y in zip(ai_ipo_x, ai_ipo_y):
    ax3.text(x + bw/2, y + 6, str(y), ha='center', fontsize=8.5,
             color=C["ai"], fontfamily='serif')

# Direct labels for era identification
ax3.text(5 + bw/2 + 0.2, dc_ipo_y[-1], 'Dot-com', fontsize=10.5, color=C["dotcom"],
         fontfamily='serif', va='center')
ax3.text(3 + bw/2 + 0.2, ai_ipo_y[-1], 'AI', fontsize=10.5, color=C["ai"],
         fontfamily='serif', va='center')

# Annotation for 1999 IPO surge
ax3.annotate(
    "Dot-com IPO\nfrenzy peak",
    xy=(2 - bw/2, 308),
    xytext=(3.5, 300),
    fontsize=8.5, fontstyle='italic', color=C["dotcom"], fontfamily='serif',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=C["dotcom"], lw=0.5),
)

yr_labels = ["Yr 1\n'97/'21", "Yr 2\n'98/'22", "Yr 3\n'99/'23",
             "Yr 4\n'00/'24", "Yr 5\n'01", "Yr 6\n'02"]

range_frame(ax3, -0.5, 5.5, 0, max(dc_ipo_y) * 1.18)
ax3.set_xticks(range(6))
ax3.set_xticklabels(yr_labels, fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylabel("Tech IPOs", fontsize=10.5, color=C["text2"])
ax3.set_title("IPO Volume: Tech-Company Listings", fontsize=14, fontfamily='serif',
              color=C["text"], loc='left', pad=10)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel 4: Corporate Earnings
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
dc_e_x = [d["year"] - 1997 for d in dc_earn]
dc_e_y = [d["earnings_bn"] for d in dc_earn]
ai_e_x = [d["year"] - 2021 for d in ai_earn]
ai_e_y = [d["earnings_bn"] for d in ai_earn]

ax4.bar([x - bw/2 for x in dc_e_x], dc_e_y, width=bw,
        color=C["dotcom"], alpha=0.8, zorder=3)
ax4.bar([x + bw/2 for x in ai_e_x], ai_e_y, width=bw,
        color=C["ai"], alpha=0.8, zorder=3)

# Zero line
ax4.axhline(y=0, color=C["axis"], linewidth=0.5, zorder=2)

# Value labels on AI bars
for x, y in zip(ai_e_x, ai_e_y):
    ax4.text(x + bw/2, y + 12, f'${y:.0f}B', ha='center', fontsize=8.5,
             color=C["ai"], fontfamily='serif')

# Direct labels
ax4.text(5 + bw/2 + 0.2, 25, 'Dot-com', fontsize=10.5, color=C["dotcom"],
         fontfamily='serif', va='center')
ax4.text(3 + bw/2 + 0.2, ai_e_y[-1], 'AI', fontsize=10.5, color=C["ai"],
         fontfamily='serif', va='center')

# Inset for dot-com earnings detail
inset = ax4.inset_axes([0.07, 0.58, 0.35, 0.37])
inset.bar([x - bw/2 for x in dc_e_x], dc_e_y, width=bw, color=C["dotcom"], alpha=0.8)
inset.axhline(y=0, color=C["axis"], linewidth=0.5, zorder=2)
for x, y in zip(dc_e_x, dc_e_y):
    label = f'${y:.0f}B' if y >= 0 else f'−${abs(y):.0f}B'
    offset = 1.5 if y >= 0 else -2.5

inset.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
inset.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
inset.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(-0.3, 5.3)

The chart is generated successfully at `/app/output/result.png` — a 1544×2039px PNG at 150 DPI.

**Summary of the visualization:**

4 stacked small-multiples panels with aligned timelines comparing dot-com (1997–2002) and AI (2021–2024) eras:

1. **NASDAQ Composite Trajectory** — Line overlay showing dot-com's 3× surge and crash vs. AI's moderate 1.5× rise; peak markers at Mar 2000 (305) and Q4 2024 (149)
2. **P/E Ratio** — Dot-com P/E peaked at 105× vs. AI's ~40×; shaded "speculative premium" area between the two series; historical average reference at 30×
3. **IPO Volume** — Grouped bars showing dot-com's 308-IPO frenzy in 1999 vs. AI's more moderate 198 peak in 2021
4. **Corporate Earnings** — AI-era earnings ($358–510B) dwarf dot-com ($−12 to $30B); inset detail panel for dot-com; annotation highlighting 15× earnings scale difference

Colors: steel blue (#4e79a7) for dot-com, tangerine (#f28e2b) for AI. Serif fonts, off-white background, range-frame axes, direct labels, no legends.
